annotations.title: List the communes of Algeria with their postal codes

description: List the communes (baladiyas) of Algeria from Algérie Poste's official data, read every day: each with its four-digit commune code, its French and Arabic names, its wilaya (number and names), its wilaya under loi n° 26-06 of 2026 when it is one of the 108 communes of the 11 wilayas that law created (wilaya_2026: its number 59 to 69 and slug), its postal codes and how many post offices and ATMs it has, and its daïra (daira: name, kind, wilaya; décret exécutif n° 91-306 as amended, Algiers' circonscriptions administratives). Filter by daira, by wilaya (a number from 1 to 69, 59 to 69 being the wilayas of 2026, or their slug such as aflou, barika, bou-saada) and by q (a name in French or Arabic, accents ignored, or the start of a postal code). Use it to check that a commune exists, to find its postal codes, or to list the communes a delivery zone covers. Algérie Poste lists 1,540 communes (those with a post office); the law counts 1,541. Without an API key, at most 10 rows. Algeria only.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

daira.description: Only the communes of this daïra (or Algiers circonscription administrative), by name, accents ignored.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

limit.description: Maximum number of results in the page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20. Without an API key at most 10 rows come back.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, from 0 to 10000, to read the next pages. Defaults to 0. meta.total tells how many results match. Without an API key it must be 0: a search cannot be paged.

q.description: A commune name in French or Arabic (accents ignored), or the first digits of a postal code.

wilaya.description: A wilaya number from 1 to 69 (16 for Alger, 59 to 69 the wilayas of 2026), or the slug of a wilaya created in 2026 (aflou, barika, el-kantara, bir-el-ater, el-aricha, ksar-chellala, ain-ouessara, messaad, ksar-el-boukhari, bou-saada, el-abiodh-sidi-cheikh).
